snippet.title: Am I Nima -  Official Gameplay Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Am I Nima is a psychological horror game where your one mission is to convince your mother that you are really her daughter. You’ll need to gain her trust by combining the right words in your brain to get her to trust you again. Am I Nima will be released on PC in the future.
